"""Print every sheet of an xlsx workbook as a compact grid.

Each cell shows its formula (when present) and its last-computed value, so
the model can see both what a cell does and what it currently holds without
opening the file in a spreadsheet program. Wide or tall sheets are
truncated to keep the output readable.

Usage:
    python3 dump_workbook.py <xlsx> [--max-rows N] [--max-cols N]

DEFAULT_MAX_COLS = 30


def format_cell(formula_cell, value_cell):
    formula = formula_cell.value
    value = value_cell.value
    if isinstance(formula, str) and formula.startswith("="):
        shown_value = "" if value is None else value
        return f"{formula} => {shown_value}"
    if formula is None:
        return ""
    return str(formula)

    rows = min(formula_ws.max_row, max_rows)
    cols = min(formula_ws.max_column, max_cols)

        f"### Sheet: {formula_ws.title} "
        f"(showing {rows}x{cols} of {formula_ws.max_row}x{formula_ws.max_column})"
    ]
    header = "\t".join([""] + [get_column_letter(c) for c in range(1, cols + 1)])

from openpyxl import load_workbook
from openpyxl.utils import get_column_letter

path = 'task/output.xlsx'
wb = load_workbook(path)
dst = wb['b2b, sez, de']
src = wb['cdnr']

# source data rows 5,6,7 -> destination rows 7,8,9
# mapping by header text:
# dst A=src A, B=src B, C=src C, D=src D, E=src I, F=src F, G=src G,
# H=blank, I="Credit Note", J=blank, K=src K, L=-src L, M=-src M,
# N=src N, O=src O, P=src P, Q=src Q, R=src R, S=src S, T=src T,
# U=src U, V=blank

src_rows = [5,6,7]
dst_rows = [7,8,9]

for sr, dr in zip(src_rows, dst_rows):
    dst.cell(row=dr, column=1).value = src.cell(row=sr, column=1).value   # A
    dst.cell(row=dr, column=2).value = src.cell(row=sr, column=2).value   # B
    dst.cell(row=dr, column=3).value = src.cell(row=sr, column=3).value   # C
    dst.cell(row=dr, column=4).value = src.cell(row=sr, column=4).value   # D
    dst.cell(row=dr, column=5).value = src.cell(row=sr, column=9).value   # E = src I
    dst.cell(row=dr, column=6).value = src.cell(row=sr, column=6).value   # F
    dst.cell(row=dr, column=7).value = src.cell(row=sr, column=7).value   # G
    # H blank
    dst.cell(row=dr, column=9).value = "Credit Note"                      # I
    # J blank
    dst.cell(row=dr, column=11).value = src.cell(row=sr, column=11).value # K
    dst.cell(row=dr, column=12).value = -src.cell(row=sr, column=12).value # L
    dst.cell(row=dr, column=13).value = -src.cell(row=sr, column=13).value # M
    dst.cell(row=dr, column=14).value = src.cell(row=sr, column=14).value  # N
    dst.cell(row=dr, column=15).value = src.cell(row=sr, column=15).value  # O
    dst.cell(row=dr, column=16).value = src.cell(row=sr, column=16).value # P
    dst.cell(row=dr, column=17).value = src.cell(row=sr, column=17).value # Q
    dst.cell(row=dr, column=18).value = src.cell(row=sr, column=18).value  # R
    dst.cell(row=dr, column=19).value = src.cell(row=sr, column=19).value # S
    dst.cell(row=dr, column=20).value = src.cell(row=sr, column=20).value # T
    dst.cell(row=dr, column=21).value = src.cell(row=sr, column=21).value # U
    # V blank

wb.save(path)
print("done")
EOF
